scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; checked command syntax and flags against the current Microsoft Learn reference; reviewed the safety warning, desktop steps, image references, and metadata.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date, restored the original publication date (2023-04-11), and set lastmod to the review date in all editions.

Changed the shortcut command from `shutdown.exe -s -f -t 0` to `shutdown.exe /s /t 0`. Microsoft documents `/f` as forcing applications closed and warns this can lose unsaved data; the updated command omits `/f`.
Clarified that the shortcut starts shutdown immediately without an extra confirmation step; advises saving work and notes apps may report unsaved changes.
Removed outdated Japanese Windows screenshots that showed the unsafe forced-close command; replaced them with localized text instructions and the exact current command.
